input.headline: East Asian democracy and Gulf federation agree several cooperation memorandums at leaders' summit covering artificial intelligence, aerospace and nuclear energy, including joint work on a US-backed giant AI data campus.

input_full.excerpt: South Korea and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) have signed seven memorandums of understanding to expand cooperation in strategic sectors (including AI, aerospace and nuclear energy) during a summit between President Lee Jae Myung and UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. Notably, South Korea has agreed to work with the UAE on the US-backed Stargate project to build a massive new AI data campus in the UAE. Earlier, in October 2025, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix signed initial agreements to supply memory chips for OpenAI's Stargate data centers.
input_full.headline: South Korea and UAE sign MOUs on AI
